sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Dated February 14, 2026. Introduces Pro/Lite/Mini and a dedicated Code model, with Code available through TRAE and the series API through Volcano Engine.

sources.title: Model list
sources.evidence: Exact doubao-seed-2-0-code-preview-260215 row lists 256k context, 224k input, 128k output and thinking, text generation, visual understanding, and function calling. Listed as approaching retirement; documentation does not establish endpoint operation.

sources.title: Deep thinking
sources.evidence: Exact Code preview revision supports enabled (default) and disabled thinking, and returning original reasoning content in tool-calling conversations. Accessed indexed content; direct web fetch timed out.

sources.title: Video understanding
sources.evidence: Supported models are explicitly the visual-understanding list, which includes Code. Responses and Chat APIs accept videos. The token-budget explanation uses 80k = 81920 = 80 × 1024. Full HTML accessed directly after web-parser timeout.

sources.title: Seed2.0 official repository
sources.evidence: Official repository presents the Pro/Lite/Mini/Code family and API cookbook. Apache-2.0 is explicitly for the repository, not a license for Code model weights; no weight release is supplied.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: 78-page PDF fetched directly and text inspected. Scope is Pro/Lite/Mini; no dedicated Code total/active parameter count or architecture disclosure. Its sibling benchmarks cannot specify Code internals.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Later 73-page PDF fetched directly and searched for exact Seed2.0 Code references, parameters and architecture. No exact Code parameter/active count or architecture disclosure found in its comparison material.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement
sources.evidence: Proprietary service terms grant restricted use; section 2.2 reserves intellectual-property rights and 2.3 prohibits extraction of confidential model parameters. Covers the Doubao model services offered on Ark.

sources.title: Coding Plan model release announcements
sources.evidence: The February 14, 2026 entry names doubao-seed-2.0-code and describes dedicated coding, frontend and multilingual development, built on Seed 2.0 agent and visual-understanding capabilities.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity (June 2026)
sources.evidence: Parent read the later June 30 first-party report and searched its model comparisons and technical terminology. No exact Seed 2.0 Code total/active count or production architecture disclosure was found; references to parameters and architecture concern task examples rather than model internals.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official Seed2.0 Code name; Ark revision is doubao-seed-2-0-code-preview-260215.

developer.note: Developed by ByteDance Seed; Volcano Engine provides the API.

family.note: Dedicated Code member of the Seed2.0 family.

release_date.note: First-party launch date and exact Code Coding Plan release agree. The API suffix 260215 is a revision identifier, not the earliest release date.

open_weights.note: Distributed as a proprietary hosted model. The public repository is an API cookbook; its code license does not release model weights.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model service; not Apache-2.0, which applies only to the cookbook repository.

parameters_b.note: No exact Code total parameter disclosure found in original/later model cards or exact-name first-party technical searches; no sibling sizes transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact Code active-parameter disclosure found; cannot infer from undisclosed total or architecture.

architecture.note: No exact Code architecture found in the accessed cards or exact-name first-party training/interpretability searches; neither dense nor MoE assumed.

context_window.note: Provider states 256k; represented as nominal decimal 256K, not a verified exact token boundary. The video guide uses a separate 81920-token (80 × 1024) budget, which does not establish a 262144-token context boundary for Code. Maximum input is separately 224k.

modalities.note: Exact Code revision appears in text generation and visual-understanding lists. The video guide explicitly uses that visual-support list for video input; no sibling modality transfer.

reasoning.note: Exact Code preview revision supports thinking enabled by default and disabled; configurable, not mandatory.

tool_call.note: Exact Code row explicitly supports function calling through Chat and Responses APIs.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model specialized for coding, with visual understanding, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Replace broad long-running-agent language with dedicated coding and documented visual/reasoning/tool capabilities.

patch.description: ByteDance Seed 2.0 model specialized for coding, with visual understanding, configurable reasoning, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Official API revision: doubao-seed-2-0-code-preview-260215. Earliest documented release: 2026-02-14. Volcano Engine documents 256k context (represented as nominal decimal 256000), 224k maximum input, and 128k maximum output. An exact 262144-token context boundary is not established. The exact Code revision is marked as approaching retirement; no endpoint availability test was performed. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed for Code; Pro/Lite/Mini specifications are not substituted.

summary: Confirmed February 14 release, nominal 256K context, text/image/video inputs, text output, configurable reasoning and tool calls for the exact Code preview revision. Added proprietary license, narrowed description and normalized context to nominal decimal 256000 without asserting an exact boundary. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed after checking the original and later model cards; hosted endpoint operation was not tested.
